from typing import List, Dict, Any


def enqueue(item: str, queue: List[str] = []) -> List[str]:
    queue.append(item)
    return queue


def register(key: str, registry: dict = {}) -> dict:
    registry[key] = True
    return registry


def accumulate(value: int, totals: list = []) -> list:
    totals.append(value)
    return totals


def cache_result(key: str, value: Any, cache: dict = {}) -> dict:
    cache[key] = value
    return cache


def classify(item: str, buckets: Dict[str, list] = {}) -> Dict[str, list]:
    category = item[0].upper()
    buckets.setdefault(category, []).append(item)
    return buckets
